reviews.comment: 70% of your grade depends on lecture exams and the exams were hard. the only extra credit was from doing the course evaluation. tests took forever to grade and was all mcq. didn't seem like he was passionate about teaching.

Dont even bother going to lecture he will just read off the slides and then on the exams make it 2x more difficult with things not even covered in the slides. You are better off just using the SI sessions and the quizlets online of past exams. If you want to torture yourself, then get ready to memorize every little thing on his slides.

Lectures can be pretty boring, but it's important to attend because he tells you exactly what will be on the exam. A lot of the practice questions from the SI leaders are on the exams so make sure to look over those. Overall, not a difficult course, but you will have to teach yourself.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The prof that forgets he's getting paid to do this job. All practice completely dependent on the SI or self learning. Not a hard class in terms of material, but made harder by subpar teaching. Doable if you just self learn, don't expect anything from lecture. Not designed to fail you, but definitely not to help you succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are many quizlets out there you can use to study. This class is not hard. I stopped going to class after the first exam then pulled all nighters the night before and got A's. He doesn't care about the class so use it to your advantage. The SI was very helpful. This is not a hard class but not one where you can slack off because it will hurt.

TAKE WITH SOMEONE ELSE, YOUR GRADE WILL TANK IF YOU DO POORLY ON ONLY ONE EXAM. The entire lecture portion (70%) is exams, no curves, no extra credit, no nothing. Very bland lectures, hard to understand too. Wouldn't doubt that Parades is a good person but NOT a good prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Retaking this class because of his lack of transparency. He does NOT care about teaching this subject; that is clear when he shows up to lecture. He is here for research only, and you can see that when you see his lack of interest in lecturing. Take 351 with a better prof.

It is clear Parades is only here to do his research. He does not care about his students or their learning. He only reads off of the slides and often cannot find the words to describe the horribly pixelated screenshots from a textbook. Lecture grade is composed of 4 exams and comprehensive final. Online lab assignments are your only grade saver.

He was kind of rude. He struggles to find the right words to explain the material. He reads off slides; many of the slides are copy pasted images from the book with no added context. The only grades are 4 lecture exams which usually have very specific questions, as in memorize all the slides.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Rude, unhelpful, and seems to hate teaching. I emailed him 5 times throughout the semester and got 1 response. Very derogatory if you ask for help and reads directly off his slides. He always seems like he does not want to be there and is extremely unhelpful if you miss an exam due to being sick. Would not recommend him to anyone.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His exams are okay, but I always scored lower than expected. His lectures aren't very helpful, and he can be a bit rude at times. Also, your grade depends on 4 exams and a final only, so try not to mess up any of the exams. Do NOT take makeup exams, he makes them much harder. The lab was not bad.
I wouldn't recommend. Not a great lecturer. Take someone else if possible. Exams are the only grades for lectures, and if you mess up on one of them, you're cooked.

Lectures were not great, but his exams were straight forward enough if you studied the slides and textbook. Definitely not the prof to take if you want to learn, but getting an A in his class was not too difficult (even if you skip lecture). Lab meets twice a week, but was not hard and the easy lab assignments boost your grade.

Exam questions are way more in depth than information given in slides. So much material to memorize and his lectures don't enhance learning, he just reads off slides. Some slides just don't have a lot of context, which can make studying hard. SI was helpful and lab isn't too bad but he has an attitude sometimes.

Not awful, just memorize the slides and you should do fine. Only graded by exams which is a little rough. Could be sassy but mostly just read off the slides, sometimes gives out practice exams w/ questions that appear on the test. Lab tests were difficult
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Material was pretty easy and exams were straightforward, but the prof was not great at lecturing. I never went to class and was thankfully able to snag an A only using the slides and textbooks. This class can be a somewhat easy A if you maximize points on the easy lab assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would recommend any other option. He just reads off his slides every lecture and is difficult to get a hold of outside class. The exams are worth all your grade. The lab is not bad but I'm glad this class is over.

This class has four exams and then a final that is your entire grade. His lectures are difficult to understand because he mumbles but he does give you the slides to his lectures that you can go back and study. Be sure to do well on the exams or else you won't do well in this class!

he was passive-aggressive and condescending to students as the semester progressed. He stopped posting practice tests after exam 2 and gave us study guides which did not help. Mumbles and reads off slides, lecture is only helpful for giving small explanations to slides that had no context given.

reviews.comment:
Test Heavy, he reads off slides and is condescending with questions. He gives exam practice but there's no answers and the format gets lazy and less helpful the further into the semester. 
If you have to take him memorize the slides and buy the "optional" textbook as a bunch of his figures and explanations come from there

Not the best instructor out there. If you seriously want to learn, do not sign up for this guy. He fails to elaborate on some stuff while lecturing as he reads off his slides majority of the time. reviews.comment: Dr. Paredes seemed very nice but was a little quiet, so sit in the front if you can. He records his lectures which was nice and gives out practice questions for exams. Mumbles during lecture so sit in the front, but there is no benefit to attending lectures. Dr. Paredes is more focused on his C. Difficile research than his actual class. Lectures were extremely boring and he speaks softly into the microphone. The exams are not difficult and his practice exams are typically helpful. However, he will never admit when he is wrong or if there is a key error. The lab is not difficult if you have a good TA.

Research-oriented so he doesn't care about being a professor. Very uninterested in teaching and frequently gets things wrong during lecture which is annoying. Lab is fine if you have a good TA. Take someone else if you can. If not, just memorize the slides.

He cares more about his research than the class. He reads off the slides in class and then tests on the most intricate details that are not even on the slides.
